snippet.title: Ad Iterum  - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo out now! 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4149030/Ad_Iterum/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=demo-trailer

Ad Iterum is a turn-based grimdark roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.
